description: A PHP class defining a collection of filter plugins for Drupal, including methods for retrieving, initializing, sorting, and configuring filters within the Drupal filter module.

classes.name: FilterPluginCollection
classes.description: A collection class for managing filter plugins in Drupal, extending DefaultLazyPluginCollection to handle filter definitions, instantiation, sorting, and configuration management.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a filter plugin instance by its ID, delegating to the parent class.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all available filter definitions and ensures instances are created for each, excluding the null filter.

methods.name: initializePlugin
methods.description: Initializes a filter plugin instance with merged configuration, based on its definition and existing configurations.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Ensures all filters are loaded and sorts the collection.

methods.name: sortHelper
methods.description: Provides comparison logic for sorting filters based on status, weight, and provider.

methods.name: getConfiguration
methods.description: Returns the collection's configuration, excluding default values to prevent default filters from appearing in stored config.
